execution_contract.fresh_capture: Five exact auth store/state primary rows, complete logical local/effective stores, six cache bytes/absence, original config, registry exact named row, private native config inputs and actual SDK/module/native pins. No production write or atomic-global claim.
execution_contract.sqlite_safety: Reuse guarded exact readonly query semantics only with existing valid sidecars; missing-sidecar/permission fallback requires an explicitly reviewed stable FD copy of bounded input. No guessed schema or SQL on a newly copied incomplete WAL set.
execution_contract.config_diff: Owned copy changes four AuthBus connection fields only; separate owned filesystem/non-started messaging isolation fields explicitly enumerated and audited. All auth flags/hostId/model/runtime/homeScope/order/usage remain original.
execution_contract.egress: Inherit actual Mac sandbox-exec policy across installed Node launcher and native child. Allow only the one owned loopback TLS server; deny production credential/config/agent/state paths and external provider/J3160. Probe real kernel containment before any credential-bearing native child.
execution_contract.credentials: Exact same managed1/2 source identities/generations from previously reviewed private source packet plus current capture; verify original provider/type/account/email identity privately. Never fabricate tokens or synthetic generations, never force selection.
execution_contract.prior_phase_scope: One aggregate deadline per initial/cold/rollback phase across all five agents; not five fresh120 deadlines. Final controller/manager outer limits must be stated as new if historical envelope cannot be recovered.
execution_contract.before_unknown_stop: Record every unsafe dispatch before send; an unknown response, generation conflict, unreaped child or ambiguous manager transition stops the chain. Do not initiate a later business/cold operation.
execution_contract.inverse: Consume durable once marker before exact expected-state inverse. Restore SDK local+effective first, primary raw row/updated_at/absence next, then six caches full byte/identity CAS. Restore original owned config. Verify all five agents and native source custody. No shared KV/history rewind.
execution_contract.source_fences: Recheck source/code/normal artifacts/config/all selected primary rows/cache/native inputs and original gateway/relay registrations at terminal. Drift is reported and never overwritten.
